en.text: So all Israel were listed by genealogies; and behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel. Judah was carried away captive to Babylon for their disobedience.

footnotes.text: 9:1 “Behold”, from “הִנֵּה*”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection.

zhSimplified.text: 以色列人都按家谱计算，写在以色列诸王记上。犹大人因犯罪就被掳到巴比伦。

zhTraditional.text: 以色列人都按家譜計算，寫在以色列諸王記上。猶大人因犯罪就被擄到巴比倫。

en.text: Now the first inhabitants who lived in their possessions in their cities were Israel, the priests, the Levites, and the temple servants.

zhSimplified.text: 先从巴比伦回来，住在自己地业城邑中的有以色列人、祭司、利未人、尼提宁的首领。

zhTraditional.text: 先從巴比倫回來，住在自己地業城邑中的有以色列人、祭司、利未人、尼提寧的首領。

en.text: In Jerusalem, there lived of the children of Judah, of the children of Benjamin, and of the children of Ephraim and Manasseh:

zhSimplified.text: 住在耶路撒冷的有犹大人、便雅悯人、以法莲人、玛拿西人。

zhTraditional.text: 住在耶路撒冷的有猶大人、便雅憫人、以法蓮人、瑪拿西人。

en.text: Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the children of Perez the son of Judah.

zhSimplified.text: 犹大儿子法勒斯的子孙中有乌太。乌太是亚米忽的儿子；亚米忽是暗利的儿子；暗利是音利的儿子；音利是巴尼的儿子。

zhTraditional.text: 猶大兒子法勒斯的子孫中有烏太。烏太是亞米忽的兒子；亞米忽是暗利的兒子；暗利是音利的兒子；音利是巴尼的兒子。

en.text: Of the Shilonites: Asaiah the firstborn and his sons.

zhSimplified.text: 示罗的子孙中有长子亚帅雅和他的众子。

zhTraditional.text: 示羅的子孫中有長子亞帥雅和他的眾子。

en.text: Of the sons of Zerah: Jeuel and their brothers, six hundred ninety.

zhSimplified.text: 谢拉的子孙中有耶乌利和他的弟兄，共六百九十人。

zhTraditional.text: 謝拉的子孫中有耶烏利和他的弟兄，共六百九十人。

en.text: Of the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hassenuah;

zhSimplified.text: 便雅悯人中有哈西努的曾孙、何达威雅的孙子、米书兰的儿子撒路，

zhTraditional.text: 便雅憫人中有哈西努的曾孫、何達威雅的孫子、米書蘭的兒子撒路，

en.text: and Ibneiah the son of Jeroham, and Elah the son of Uzzi, the son of Michri; and Meshullam the son of Shephatiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah;

zhSimplified.text: 又有耶罗罕的儿子伊比尼雅，米基立的孙子、乌西的儿子以拉，伊比尼雅的曾孙、流珥的孙子、示法提雅的儿子米书兰，

zhTraditional.text: 又有耶羅罕的兒子伊比尼雅，米基立的孫子、烏西的兒子以拉，伊比尼雅的曾孫、流珥的孫子、示法提雅的兒子米書蘭，

en.text: and their brothers, according to their generations, nine hundred fifty-six. All these men were heads of fathers’ households by their fathers’ houses.

zhSimplified.text: 和他们的族弟兄，按着家谱计算共有九百五十六名。这些人都是他们的族长。

zhTraditional.text: 和他們的族弟兄，按着家譜計算共有九百五十六名。這些人都是他們的族長。

en.text: Of the priests: Jedaiah, Jehoiarib, Jachin,

zhSimplified.text: 祭司中有耶大雅、耶何雅立、雅斤，

zhTraditional.text: 祭司中有耶大雅、耶何雅立、雅斤，

en.text: and Azariah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of God’s house;

zhSimplified.text: 还有管理 神殿希勒家的儿子亚萨利雅。希勒家是米书兰的儿子；米书兰是撒督的儿子；撒督是米拉约的儿子；米拉约是亚希突的儿子。

zhTraditional.text: 還有管理上帝殿希勒家的兒子亞薩利雅。希勒家是米書蘭的兒子；米書蘭是撒督的兒子；撒督是米拉約的兒子；米拉約是亞希突的兒子。

en.text: and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah; and Maasai the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;

zhSimplified.text: 有玛基雅的曾孙、巴施户珥的孙子、耶罗罕的儿子亚大雅，又有亚第业的儿子玛赛；亚第业是雅希细拉的儿子；雅希细拉是米书兰的儿子；米书兰是米实利密的儿子；米实利密是音麦的儿子。

zhTraditional.text: 有瑪基雅的曾孫、巴施戶珥的孫子、耶羅罕的兒子亞大雅，又有亞第業的兒子瑪賽；亞第業是雅希細拉的兒子；雅希細拉是米書蘭的兒子；米書蘭是米實利密的兒子；米實利密是音麥的兒子。

en.text: and their brothers, heads of their fathers’ houses, one thousand seven hundred sixty; they were very able men for the work of the service of God’s house.

zhSimplified.text: 他们和众弟兄都是族长，共有一千七百六十人，是善于做 神殿使用之工的。

zhTraditional.text: 他們和眾弟兄都是族長，共有一千七百六十人，是善於做上帝殿使用之工的。

en.text: Of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;

zhSimplified.text: 利未人米拉利的子孙中，有哈沙比雅的曾孙、押利甘的孙子、哈述的儿子示玛雅。

zhTraditional.text: 利未人米拉利的子孫中，有哈沙比雅的曾孫、押利甘的孫子、哈述的兒子示瑪雅。

en.text: and Bakbakkar, Heresh, Galal, and Mattaniah the son of Mica, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph,

zhSimplified.text: 有拔巴甲、黑勒施、迦拉，并亚萨的曾孙、细基利的孙子、米迦的儿子玛探雅，

zhTraditional.text: 有拔巴甲、黑勒施、迦拉，並亞薩的曾孫、細基利的孫子、米迦的兒子瑪探雅，

en.text: and Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun; and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, who lived in the villages of the Netophathites.

zhSimplified.text: 又有耶杜顿的曾孙、迦拉的孙子、示玛雅的儿子俄巴底，还有以利加拿的孙子、亚撒的儿子比利家。他们都住在尼陀法人的村庄。

zhTraditional.text: 又有耶杜頓的曾孫、迦拉的孫子、示瑪雅的兒子俄巴底，還有以利加拿的孫子、亞撒的兒子比利家。他們都住在尼陀法人的村莊。

en.text: The gatekeepers: Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, and their brothers (Shallum was the chief),

zhSimplified.text: 守门的是沙龙、亚谷、达们、亚希幔，和他们的弟兄；沙龙为长。

zhTraditional.text: 守門的是沙龍、亞谷、達們、亞希幔，和他們的弟兄；沙龍為長。

en.text: who previously served in the king’s gate eastward. They were the gatekeepers for the camp of the children of Levi.

zhSimplified.text: 从前这些人看守朝东的王门，如今是利未营中守门的。

zhTraditional.text: 從前這些人看守朝東的王門，如今是利未營中守門的。

en.text: Shallum was the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brothers, of his father’s house, the Korahites, were over the work of the service, keepers of the thresholds of the tent. Their fathers had been over the LORD’s camp, keepers of the entry.

zhSimplified.text: 可拉的曾孙、以比雅撒的孙子、可利的儿子沙龙，和他的族弟兄可拉人都管理使用之工，并守会幕的门。他们的祖宗曾管理耶和华的营盘，又把守营门。

zhTraditional.text: 可拉的曾孫、以比雅撒的孫子、可利的兒子沙龍，和他的族弟兄可拉人都管理使用之工，並守會幕的門。他們的祖宗曾管理耶和華的營盤，又把守營門。

en.text: Phinehas the son of Eleazar was ruler over them in time past, and the LORD was with him.

zhSimplified.text: 从前以利亚撒的儿子非尼哈管理他们，耶和华也与他同在。

zhTraditional.text: 從前以利亞撒的兒子非尼哈管理他們，耶和華也與他同在。

en.text: Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was gatekeeper of the door of the Tent of Meeting.

zhSimplified.text: 米施利米雅的儿子撒迦利雅是看守会幕之门的。

zhTraditional.text: 米施利米雅的兒子撒迦利雅是看守會幕之門的。

en.text: All these who were chosen to be gatekeepers in the thresholds were two hundred twelve. These were listed by genealogy in their villages, whom David and Samuel the seer ordained in their office of trust.

zhSimplified.text: 被选守门的人共有二百一十二名。他们在自己的村庄，按着家谱计算，是大卫和先见撒母耳所派当这紧要职任的。

zhTraditional.text: 被選守門的人共有二百一十二名。他們在自己的村莊，按着家譜計算，是大衛和先見撒母耳所派當這緊要職任的。

en.text: So they and their children had the oversight of the gates of the LORD’s house, even the house of the tent, as guards.

zhSimplified.text: 他们和他们的子孙按着班次看守耶和华殿的门，就是会幕的门。

zhTraditional.text: 他們和他們的子孫按着班次看守耶和華殿的門，就是會幕的門。

en.text: On the four sides were the gatekeepers, toward the east, west, north, and south.

zhSimplified.text: 在东西南北，四方都有守门的。

zhTraditional.text: 在東西南北，四方都有守門的。

en.text: Their brothers, in their villages, were to come in every seven days from time to time to be with them,

zhSimplified.text: 他们的族弟兄住在村庄，每七日来与他们换班。

zhTraditional.text: 他們的族弟兄住在村莊，每七日來與他們換班。

en.text: for the four chief gatekeepers, who were Levites, were in an office of trust, and were over the rooms and over the treasuries in God’s house.

zhSimplified.text: 这四个门领都是利未人，各有紧要的职任，看守 神殿的仓库。

zhTraditional.text: 這四個門領都是利未人，各有緊要的職任，看守上帝殿的倉庫。

en.text: They stayed around God’s house, because that was their duty; and it was their duty to open it morning by morning.

zhSimplified.text: 他们住在 神殿的四围，是因委托他们守殿，要每日早晨开门。

zhTraditional.text: 他們住在上帝殿的四圍，是因委託他們守殿，要每日早晨開門。

en.text: Certain of them were in charge of the vessels of service, for these were brought in by count, and these were taken out by count.

zhSimplified.text: 利未人中有管理使用器皿的，按着数目拿出拿入；

zhTraditional.text: 利未人中有管理使用器皿的，按着數目拿出拿入；

en.text: Some of them also were appointed over the furniture, and over all the vessels of the sanctuary, over the fine flour, the wine, the oil, the frankincense, and the spices.

zhSimplified.text: 又有人管理器具和圣所的器皿，并细面、酒、油、乳香、香料。

zhTraditional.text: 又有人管理器具和聖所的器皿，並細麵、酒、油、乳香、香料。

en.text: Some of the sons of the priests prepared the mixing of the spices.

zhSimplified.text: 祭司中有人用香料做膏油。

zhTraditional.text: 祭司中有人用香料做膏油。

en.text: Mattithiah, one of the Levites, who was the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, had the office of trust over the things that were baked in pans.

zhSimplified.text: 利未人玛他提雅是可拉族沙龙的长子，他紧要的职任是管理盘中烤的物。

zhTraditional.text: 利未人瑪他提雅是可拉族沙龍的長子，他緊要的職任是管理盤中烤的物。

en.text: Some of their brothers, of the sons of the Kohathites, were over the show bread, to prepare it every Sabbath.

zhSimplified.text: 他们族弟兄哥辖子孙中，有管理陈设饼的，每安息日预备摆列。

zhTraditional.text: 他們族弟兄哥轄子孫中，有管理陳設餅的，每安息日預備擺列。

en.text: These are the singers, heads of fathers’ households of the Levites, who lived in the rooms and were free from other service, for they were employed in their work day and night.

zhSimplified.text: 歌唱的有利未人的族长，住在属殿的房屋，昼夜供职，不做别样的工。

zhTraditional.text: 歌唱的有利未人的族長，住在屬殿的房屋，晝夜供職，不做別樣的工。

en.text: These were heads of fathers’ households of the Levites, throughout their generations, chief men. They lived at Jerusalem.

zhSimplified.text: 以上都是利未人著名的族长，住在耶路撒冷。 （代上8·29—38）

zhTraditional.text: 以上都是利未人著名的族長，住在耶路撒冷。 （代上8‧29－38）

en.text: Jeiel the father of Gibeon, whose wife’s name was Maacah, lived in Gibeon.

zhSimplified.text: 在基遍住的有基遍的父亲耶利。他的妻名叫玛迦；

zhTraditional.text: 在基遍住的有基遍的父親耶利。他的妻名叫瑪迦；

en.text: His firstborn son was Abdon, then Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,

zhSimplified.text: 他长子是亚伯顿。他又生苏珥、基士、巴力、尼珥、拿答、

zhTraditional.text: 他長子是亞伯頓。他又生蘇珥、基士、巴力、尼珥、拿答、

en.text: Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah, and Mikloth.

zhSimplified.text: 基多、亚希约、撒迦利雅、米基罗。

zhTraditional.text: 基多、亞希約、撒迦利雅、米基羅。

en.text: Mikloth became the father of Shimeam. They also lived with their relatives in Jerusalem, near their relatives.

zhSimplified.text: 米基罗生示米暗。这些人和他们的弟兄在耶路撒冷对面居住。

zhTraditional.text: 米基羅生示米暗。這些人和他們的弟兄在耶路撒冷對面居住。

en.text: Ner became the father of Kish. Kish became the father of Saul. Saul became the father of Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.

zhSimplified.text: 尼珥生基士；基士生扫罗；扫罗生约拿单、麦基舒亚、亚比拿达、伊施·巴力。

zhTraditional.text: 尼珥生基士；基士生掃羅；掃羅生約拿單、麥基舒亞、亞比拿達、伊施‧巴力。

en.text: The son of Jonathan was Merib-baal. Merib-baal became the father of Micah.

zhSimplified.text: 约拿单的儿子是米力·巴力；米力·巴力生米迦。

zhTraditional.text: 約拿單的兒子是米力‧巴力；米力‧巴力生米迦。

en.text: The sons of Micah: Pithon, Melech, Tahrea, and Ahaz.

zhSimplified.text: 米迦的儿子是毗敦、米勒、他利亚、亚哈斯。

zhTraditional.text: 米迦的兒子是毗敦、米勒、他利亞、亞哈斯。

en.text: Ahaz became the father of Jarah. Jarah became the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri. Zimri became the father of Moza.

zhSimplified.text: 亚哈斯生雅拉；雅拉生亚拉篾、亚斯玛威、心利；心利生摩撒；

zhTraditional.text: 亞哈斯生雅拉；雅拉生亞拉篾、亞斯瑪威、心利；心利生摩撒；

en.text: Moza became the father of Binea, Rephaiah his son, Eleasah his son, and Azel his son.

zhSimplified.text: 摩撒生比尼亚；比尼亚生利法雅；利法雅的儿子是以利亚萨；以利亚萨的儿子是亚悉。

zhTraditional.text: 摩撒生比尼亞；比尼亞生利法雅；利法雅的兒子是以利亞薩；以利亞薩的兒子是亞悉。

en.text: Azel had six sons, whose names are Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. These were the sons of Azel.

zhSimplified.text: 亚悉有六个儿子，他们的名字是亚斯利干、波基路、以实玛利、示亚利雅、俄巴底雅、哈难。这都是亚悉的儿子。

zhTraditional.text: 亞悉有六個兒子，他們的名字是亞斯利干、波基路、以實瑪利、示亞利雅、俄巴底雅、哈難。這都是亞悉的兒子。
